facts.statement: Flitter gives daily invitations to hand out; players pick invitations next to Flitter and trade for more. Having more invitations than Flitter earns a special prize.
facts.quote: When you’ve gotten more invitations than Flitter, head back and you’ll get a special prize!

article_summaries.title: Ref Ruby's Birthday Party Guide - Part 2
article_summaries.summary: Part two of an official guide to the Free Realms 1st birthday party events, covering daily quests: cake bake-off chef sponsorship with Camellia, Flitter's invitation contest, Quills' balloon trade, Helga's feast ingredients, and the Cakenstein boss fights in Sanctuary and Queensfields. The page gives no exact date beyond a relative 'posted 3 years, 10 months ago' timestamp, so the event is dated only by its 1st-birthday framing (about spring 2010).
